entities.summary: Jasrado Prince Hermis Arrington "Jazz" Chisholm Jr. is a Bahamian professional baseball infielder and center fielder for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Miami Marlins. Chisholm signed with the Arizona Diamondbacks as an international free agent in 2015, and made his MLB debut in 2020 with the Marlins. He has been named an All-Star in 2022 and 2025. Chisholm has competed internationally for the Great Britain national baseball team.
